claims.claim: MAS opened a stablecoin consultation on 1 Sept
claims.reason: All three sources say MAS published the stablecoin consultation paper on 1 September 2026.
The sources give 16 October 2026 as the deadline for comments. This is a scheduled date, not an event that happened after the run date.

claims.claim: The stablecoin consultation includes clarifications for banks
claims.reason: S2 says the paper covers clarifications for banks, merchant banks and wholesale banks that intend to issue stablecoins. S3 adds that banks must issue through a separate non-bank entity.

claims.claim: MAS's bank corporate governance paper came 30 Sept, outside the period
claims.reason: None of the cited sources mentions a bank corporate governance paper. Its stated date, 30 Sept 2026, is also after the 2026-09-24 run date.
